tasks.short: Establish and maintain credible source relationships.

steps.what: Retrieve permitted source contact preferences and prior agreed contact restrictions
Establish and maintain relationships with credible information sources through personal conversations and trust-building
outputs: actual relationship commitments and contact restrictions

steps.what: Write minimal actual contact commitments and restrictions in a protected source note
inputs: actual relationship commitments and contact restrictions

steps.what: Approve the final minimal contact note and protected record association
Commit the approved contact note to the restricted source record
Write the specific follow-up message consistent with the source's agreed contact restrictions
inputs: actual relationship commitments and contact restrictions
outputs: final proposed source follow-up and destination

steps.what: Approve the final source message, secure channel and exact contact destination
inputs: final proposed source follow-up and destination

steps.what: Send the exact approved follow-up through the agreed protected source channel

tasks.design: Configure native protected contact views and approved send/save actions in {OTHER}, the newsroom's secure source-contact and messaging tools. Conversations, minimal source notes and individual message writing stay human; separate final-version approvals govern internal note commitment and external follow-up sending. Edits invalidate approval, the agreed secure channel is retained, and no source content enters a model or an ordinary marketing contact system.
tasks.previous_blocker: Small contact lookup and follow-up filing steps surround otherwise personal source work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native restricted views and explicit save/send controls can remove navigation and repeated filing.
tasks.still_hard: Trust, credibility and understanding a source's risk.
tasks.human_edge: Maintain personal accountability to sources and protect agreed boundaries.

ambition.what: Support existing relationships with less contact administration.

tasks.altitude: Source relationships remain the journalist's work.

reach.learn: Use only authorized source context, with restrictions preserved.

evidence.claim: Secure contact tools can support restricted views and explicit approved save/send actions; exact capability depends on the newsroom's tools.

assumptions: The journalist produces actual contact restrictions and preferences in s3 and the final message in s6; missing prior records are checked manually in s1.
The change preserves existing source-protection practices and adds no automatic outreach or reminders.
Machine send/save removes repeated UI handling, not the time spent deciding or writing.
unknowns: Whether current secure tools already provide these views and actions.
research_questions: Is any contact lookup or filing effort removable within existing source security practices?

already_counted.description: Actual contact note and message approval remain counted.

incremental.description: Check contact view permissions and approved-action behavior.

approvals.approved_version: approved protected contact note version including restricted record association
approved source message version including exact secure channel and destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: two contact lookup and five actual send-handling hours saved less one upkeep. Low: existing secure tools remove most new benefit. Same-source-record commitment and relationship work retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Monitor authorized news feeds and public incident updates using saved topic and location filters
inputs: existing news feeds and official updates

steps.what: Investigate breaking news developments such as disasters, crimes or human-interest stories through field observation and interviews
outputs: first-hand observations and attributed witness accounts

steps.what: Verify developing claims against independent sources and distinguish confirmed facts from disputed accounts
inputs: first-hand observations and attributed witness accounts
outputs: verified development assessment and unresolved claims

steps.what: Capture verified developments and uncertainties in a newsroom update with native source links and timestamps
inputs: verified development assessment and unresolved claims
first-hand observations and attributed witness accounts
outputs: final proposed breaking-news update and editor recipient

steps.what: Approve the exact internal update, attribution, uncertainty labels and editor destination
inputs: final proposed breaking-news update and editor recipient

steps.what: Commit the approved investigation update to the internal newsroom story record
Send the approved breaking-news update to the named internal editor

tasks.design: Configure native feed filters and timestamp/source reuse in {OTHER}, the newsroom feed and story-management system, with {DOCS} notes. Field investigation and independent claim verification retain full time; the journalist captures actual findings in the update, then approves the complete internal version before separate filing and editor notification through {CHAT}. Any update or recipient change voids approval; this investigation workflow does not publish to the public or treat feed repetition as corroboration.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated feed checking and source/timestamp copying around field investigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved filters and source-linked update fields can reduce administrative work.
tasks.still_hard: Events change quickly and witnesses or authorities can be wrong.
tasks.human_edge: Investigate independently and decide what remains unconfirmed.

ambition.what: Keep the current investigation handoff traceable.

tasks.altitude: The journalist keeps responsibility for field investigation and verification.

reach.learn: Receive explicit uncertainty and source attribution with the update.

evidence.claim: Newsroom feed tools and story systems can filter leads and reuse timestamps and source links; no claim of automated verification is made.

assumptions: Feed publishers create raw updates; the journalist selects filters in s1 and captures actual field facts and attributions in s4. Missing or ambiguous claims are verified manually in s3.
Only link and timestamp recopying decreases in s4; actual note authorship remains counted.
Public story creation and publication are separate from this internal investigation handoff.
research_questions: Do native filters reduce checking effort without hiding important leads?

already_counted.description: Actual update capture and final update approval.

incremental.description: Maintain feed filters and source/timestamp fields.

approvals.approved_version: approved breaking-news update version including attribution, uncertainty and story record
approved breaking-news update version including exact editor recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:7.5 feed checking, two source/timestamp copying and three actual editor-notification hours saved less1.5 upkeep. Low: native newsroom configuration removes most new benefit. Same-newsroom-record commitment retains full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select pertinent material and organize presentation formats.

steps.what: Retrieve the verified reporting material, asset permissions and presentation brief
inputs: existing verified story material and rights records

steps.what: Select material most pertinent to presentation, balancing relevance, context and fair representation
Organize selected material into appropriate formats using native story blocks, layouts and asset references
Check context, sequence, captions and accessibility in the actual presentation preview and correct it
Approve the final formatted package for internal editorial staging
Commit the approved presentation package to the internal editorial staging record

tasks.design: Configure native asset views and layout blocks in {OTHER}, the newsroom asset and story-layout system, linked to {DOCS} and {CMS}. The journalist selects material, sets its sequence and checks the actual preview; reusable blocks reduce formatting and asset recopying only. A separate action commits the exact approved package internally, edits void approval, and public publication still needs the newsroom's later release decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected material is reformatted and relinked across presentation layouts.
tasks.enabler_now: Native story blocks and reusable asset references can replace repeated layout work.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting material without misleading through omission or juxtaposition.
tasks.human_edge: Editorial judgement about relevance, context and fairness.

ambition.what: Format current selected material with less repetition.

tasks.altitude: Material selection and contextual review remain human.

reach.learn: Reuse approved sequence and asset rights without rebuilding links.

evidence.claim: Newsroom layout and content tools support reusable story blocks and asset references.

assumptions: Reporting and asset owners create existing source material and rights records. s1 checks gaps; the journalist creates the actual selection and sequence in s2 and captions and corrections in s4.
This task ends with an internal formatted package, not a public release; no publication saving is credited here.
unknowns: How much native block reuse is already configured.
research_questions: Which formatting steps persist after existing layout features are enabled?

already_counted.description: Preview context review and final staging approval.

incremental.description: Maintain reusable blocks and preview checks.

approvals.approved_version: approved presentation staging version including preview, assets and staging destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: five source retrieval and fifteen presentation-formatting hours saved less one upkeep. Low: existing native layout removes most new benefit. Same-editorial-record staging and selection judgement retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Report news in a specialized field.

steps.what: Gather specialist-field information through interviews, primary documents and direct reporting
Analyze specialist claims, resolve contradictory evidence and decide the story's justified findings and caveats
outputs: verified specialist findings and story plan

steps.what: Write the specialized-field news report from verified findings with a bounded prose draft and native story template
inputs: verified specialist findings and story plan

loop.purpose: Draft clear prose from established specialist findings
loop.input: Reporter-approved nonconfidential findings, story plan and exact permitted quotations
loop.check: Reporter checks specialist meaning, caveats and every quotation against original evidence
loop.stop: Unsupported claim or altered quotation is rejected; two edits maximum before manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates handle layout and boilerplate; explaining the story still needs prose, while new reporting stays human.

steps.what: Verify and correct the complete specialist story and publication preview against the reporting evidence
Independently review the complete final story and approve the exact public publication version
Publish the exact editor-approved specialist report to the public news channel

tasks.design: Test native story templates in {CMS} first, with {DOCS} preserving source evidence. A bounded prose loop works only from permitted reporter-verified findings; the journalist retains reporting, specialist interpretation and claim-fidelity checks, followed by independent editor review of the complete preview. A separate action publishes only that exact approved version, any change returns to review, and confidential source material stays outside the model.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing clear specialist explanations consumes preparation time after reporting.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded prose assistance can use a verified story plan while native tools handle layout.
tasks.still_hard: Specialist uncertainty and public consequences of misleading simplification.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the field and hold claims to reporting evidence.

ambition.what: Produce existing specialist coverage with less draft preparation.

tasks.altitude: The journalist and editor retain reporting and publication accountability.

reach.learn: Check source meaning and caveats rather than just fluent prose.

evidence.claim: Language models can draft prose from selected findings, but this does not establish accuracy or task-specific time saving.

assumptions: Shares are provisional and include ten editor hours. Focal journalist baseline is 90 hours; no editor saving is claimed.
s1 counts source gathering and note capture. s2 produces explicit claim, attribution, caveat and exact quotation fields; unclear material remains manual.
s3 includes draft meaning checks, s4 reporter verification and s5 independent final editorial approval. Model use stops if permitted input separation is impractical.
This specialized report is a separate workflow case from breaking-news investigation; a roll-up must not count an identical reporting episode twice.
unknowns: Editorial policy on permitted draft inputs and model use.
research_questions: Does drafting save time after independent specialist meaning checks?

incremental.description: Maintain input restrictions and check recurring draft errors.

approvals.approved_version: editor-approved specialist story version including full preview, assets and public channel

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 7.5 draft and five publication-handling hours saved from a 90-hour journalist baseline gives 13.89% gross, less two upkeep hours per 100 journalist hours. Low case has no draft benefit after checking and native publishing already active, leaving upkeep only.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Journalism supported by native reference and formatting tools and tightly bounded prose assistance.
reach: Editors receive explicit evidence and exact final versions; source protection remains personal.
role.ambitious_version: Reduce reference and formatting repetition while retaining independent investigation, source trust and editorial responsibility.
